# Real-data format shared by the data build and the engine

Two developers work in parallel. The data developer writes `src/climate.js` and updates `src/data.js`; the engine developer writes `src/engine.js`. Both follow this file exactly. The UI and CONTRACT.md (result format) do not change.

Build order of scripts in the page (build.py): data.js, climate.js, store.js, engine.js, fieldview.js, controls.js, analysis.js, chat.js, app.js.

## src/climate.js (generated by tools/build_data.py; do not hand-edit)

```js
window.FS = window.FS || {};
FS.data = FS.data || {};
FS.data.climate = {
  meta: {
    source: 'NASA POWER daily (MERRA-2 based), community AG',
    lat: 42.03, lon: -93.47, elevation_m: 310,         // from the POWER response header
    seasonStart: '11-16',                               // a season year Y runs 16 Nov (Y-1) .. 15 Nov Y
    days: 365,                                          // 29 Feb dropped; index 0 = 16 Nov, index 46 = 1 Jan, index 365-1 = 15 Nov
    years: [1982, ..., 2025],                           // every complete season year (POWER starts 1981-01-01, so the first full season is 1982)
    typicalYear: 2009,                                  // the season whose Jun-Aug rain is closest to the median (computed)
    scale: { tmax: 10, tmin: 10, rain: 10, et0: 10, rad: 10, rh: 1, wind: 10, gwr: 100 },
    heatMatch: { c29: 29.9, c30: 31.0, c35: 38.2 },     // POWER Tmax thresholds that are exceeded as often as ERA5's 29/30/35 C (computed by the build)
    et0Check: { '2012': { power: 0, era5: 0 }, ... },   // Jun-Aug ET0 totals (mm), ours from POWER vs Open-Meteo ERA5
    accessed: '2026-11-14'
  },
  seasons: {
    '2012': {
      tmax: [ ...365 ints, deg C x10 ],
      tmin: [ ...365 ints, deg C x10 ],
      rain: [ ...365 ints, mm x10 ],                    // PRECTOTCORR
      et0:  [ ...365 ints, mm x10 ],                    // FAO-56 Penman-Monteith from POWER (Hargreaves where radiation is missing)
      rad:  [ ...365 ints, MJ/m2/day x10, -1 if missing ],
      gwr:  [ ...365 ints, GWETROOT x100 (0..100) ]     // MERRA-2 root-zone soil wetness, used only for checks and display, never as SMAP
    },
    ...
  }
};
```
Decode a value as `array[i] / scale.<var>`.

## Changes to src/data.js (data developer)
- `farm.fields[i].soil` becomes an object, measured from NRCS Soil Data Access at a real point for each field:
  `{ name: 'Coland clay loam, 0-2% slopes', awcMmPerM: 180, aws150cm: 27.07, drainage: 'Poorly drained', hydgrp: 'C/D', slopePct: 1, point: [-93.47, 42.03] }`
  where `awcMmPerM = aws0150wta (cm in 150 cm) * 10 / 1.5`. Keep `name`, `acres`, `lastCrop`, `poly`, `id` as they are.
- `farm.countyAwcMmPerM`: the county-average reference (use 180 unless the build computes better).
- `weatherScenarios`: keep the ids (typical, drought2012, wet2019, dry2023, lateFreeze, earlyFrost) and add `year` for every one: typical -> meta.typicalYear, drought2012 -> 2012, wet2019 -> 2019, dry2023 -> 2023, lateFreeze -> the season with the latest spring frost (Tmin <= 0 C) in POWER (1997 per earlier analysis), earlyFrost -> the season with the earliest fall frost (Tmin <= 0 C) (1991). Labels in plain words, e.g. 'Typical year (2009 weather)', 'Late spring frost (1997)'. `note` stays short.
- `economics`: real dated values (see the build plan): price { corn: 4.60, soybean: 12.10 } (Nov 2026 WASDE 2026/27 season-average), normalYield { corn: 211, soybean: 61, oats: 80 }, costPerAcre { corn: 911.98, cornAfterCorn: 960.02, soybean: 680, oats: 420, rye: 37 } (ISU 2026 A1-20 via secondary summaries; oats placeholder), nitrogen { lbPerAcreCornAfterSoy: 146, lbPerAcreCornAfterCorn: 190, dollarsPerLb: 0.57 }, volatility { corn: 0.15, soybean: 0.13 }, costShareRye: 30, and `asOf` / `sources` strings for each.
- `sources`: add power, openmeteo, nrcs, isu, wasde, rma, idals, fao56, fao33 entries with label and url.
- Keep `plans`, `planOptions`, `initialControls` unchanged.

## Engine reads
- Weather for a run: `FS.data.climate.seasons[String(year)]` where `year` = the selected scenario's year. Temperature shift adds to tmax/tmin (and the engine recomputes ET0 roughly: ET0 x (1 + 0.03 per deg C) is acceptable); rain change scales rain.
- Soil per field: `field.soil.awcMmPerM`, `field.soil.slopePct`, `field.soil.drainage`.
- Heat thresholds: `meta.heatMatch`.
- Normal-year scaling: S_ref = baseline rotation on `farm.countyAwcMmPerM`, no shifts, median over all `meta.years`.
